[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Publication de-flap, truthful error digests, and TUI stall [/bold #D7AFFF]

[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent_publication reports each (project, signature) cause once as a[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]standing alert with a true attempt count and backoff. Its drain [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]audited terminal state instead of staying quarantined forever. The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]scheduler error ring and hourly digest group errors by signature, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with durable true counts, a truthful coverage interval, and pruned [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]digest files. Policy-initiated TUI garbage collections and sampled [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]main-thread I/O no longer block the event loop for seconds, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]tui_stalls.jsonl stays bounded, untorn, and usable as the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]acceptance metric.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Group the scheduler error ring by signature with durable [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]interval counts[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]error_groups[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]error_groups: a sase-core normalizer turns error text into a stable [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]signature. append_error keeps a durable per-interval counter keyed by [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](routine, job, signature) next to a signature-fair sample ring. Failed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]or corrupt writes are counted and logged once instead of dropped.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Render one digest line per cause with true totals, coverage, [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]and pruning[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]digest_render[dim] · [dim][/dim]after error_groups[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]digest_render: the hourly digest snapshots and resets the interval [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]counter atomically. It renders one line per cause with count, first/last[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]time, and a sample under a true-total and coverage header, with no loss [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]after downtime or a crash. Digest files are pruned on a 30-day horizon.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Turn repeated publication failures into standing alerts with [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]backoff[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]pub_standing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after error_groups[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pub_standing: a sase-core decider keys publication failures by (project,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]signature) and reports only opened, changed, escalated, and cleared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]transitions. It backs off project-scoped failures. A standing store [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keeps true attempt counts and first/last-seen times, and one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notification per alert fires only on transitions.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Give drain cleanup a budget it can finish and sweep stranded [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]publisher scratch[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]pub_cleanup[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pub_cleanup: the drain reserves a cleanup window inside its timeout and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]records a verifiable cleanup result. Stale [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF].sase-v2-stage/.sase-v2-backup scratch is swept under the publisher [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lock. Workspace retention stops treating agents-sync scratch in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]machine-wide agents sidecar as a run's stranded work.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bound inventory_build with reuse, an incremental history [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]cache, and scoped queries[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]pub_inventory[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pub_standing, pub_cleanup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pub_inventory: build the hood inventory once per project per tick [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of once per batch. Cache parsed primary-history trailers by HEAD[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and parse only new commits. Scope index and dismissed-record queries to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the requested hoods, and give inventory_build its own deadline slice.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Keep deferred prompt sources alive and add an audited terminal[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]state[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]prompt_terminal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pub_cleanup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prompt_terminal: find why deferred prompt sources vanish and close each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gap so durable obligations keep their bytes. Add a sase-core terminal [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]outcome for genuinely unreconstructable archives. It stops retries, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]releases pool protection and any tied workspace hold, and leaves an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]audit record. It never counts as success.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the publication doctor checks report standing and [/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]

    [#D7D7AF]pub_doctor: doctor's agent_publication_outbox check groups issues by [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](project, signature) and reports audited terminal rows as settled, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the count stays flat across ticks. Apply sase-1rb remedy (a): stale-only[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rotate tui_stalls.jsonl, tolerate torn lines, and write fault [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]happens.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop policy-initiated garbage collections from blocking the [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]loop for seconds[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]gc_policy[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stall_telemetry[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gc_policy: idle, backstop, and RSS-backstop collections stay bounded. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]The policy re-freezes survivors, defers full collections while the [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]memory backstops. Before/after pause stats are recorded by trigger.[/#D7D7AF]
